original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role for EC2 instances to write CloudWatch logs and read SSM Parameter Store configuration

Parameters:
  RoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: EC2AppRole
    Description: Name of the IAM role
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  LogGroupPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/ec2/application
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group name prefix the EC2 instances may write to

  ParameterStorePath:
    Type: String
    Default: /app/config
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix the EC2 instances may read from (no trailing slash)

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional KMS key ARN used to decrypt SecureString parameters. Leave empty if not using SecureString parameters.

Conditions:
  HasKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref RoleName
      Description: Allows EC2 instances to write CloudWatch Logs and read configuration from Parameter Store
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref RoleName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudWatchLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsWriteAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCreateLogGroupAndStream
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*
          - Sid: AllowPutLogEvents
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*

  ParameterStoreReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ParameterStoreReadAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePath}
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePath}/*
          - Sid: AllowDescribeParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
            Resource: '*'

  KmsDecryptPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasKmsKey
    Properties:
      PolicyName: KmsDecryptForSecureString
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDecryptSecureStringParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${RoleName}-InstanceProfile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM role
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RoleName

  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RoleArn

  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the EC2 instance profile
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-InstanceProfileName

  InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC
